name: Kagamigawa Noel
source:
A half-Japanese, half-French girl born in Strasbourg. She went on to a girls' high school for various reasons, but it doesn’t seem to be what she expected. She is [url=https://vndb.org/c13503]Chloe[/url]’s little sister from [url=https://vndb.org/v1646/]Memories Off 6: T-Wave[/url].

[From [url=http://gematsu.com/2017/09/memories-off-innocent-fille-launch-ps4-ps-vita-pc#b5Et1Y6rjDrmUh6l.99]Gematsu[/url]]
